description:
Opt-in app-building know-how for the tenant knowledge base (AB#8779, Feature AB#8777). Installs
23 knowledge pages that answer how to build an OctoMesh app: the build sequence, HTTP API
pipelines, blueprint authoring, operator-deployed web apps, pipeline basics and DataContext,
entity updates, the Mesh Adapter and SDK pipeline nodes, and worked pipeline examples. An MCP
client finds them with knowledge_search / knowledge_get and cites them as [slug].

The pages are generated from the skills octo-app-builder and pipeline-expert of
octo-claude-skills by tools/SkillPages (AB#8490); never edit the seed by hand
(docs/skill-pages.md). Every page has kind Skill, origin Blueprint and status Verified, its
first KnowledgePageVersion (author blueprint:System.Ai.Builder-<version>, DeclaredLinks = the
page's LinksTo) and LinksTo associations to the pages it mentions.

Pages only: no pipeline, no LLM call, no service account, no client. The builder agent, its
mandate and its client are AB#8495. Not service-managed: the AI service applies only
System.Ai.Default; a tenant gets these pages only with InstallBlueprint, and
UninstallBlueprint removes them again.

Updates: the page content is TenantOwned, so a later version of this blueprint brings only new
KnowledgePageVersion entities; it never overwrites a page (AB#8778). The knowledge maintenance
of System.Ai.Knowledge 1.2.0 (AB#8780) switches an unedited page to the newest version and
reports an edited one as PlatformUpdateAvailable. This blueprint does not depend on
System.Ai.Knowledge on purpose (that blueprint carries the LLM ingest pipelines and needs an
API key); without it a person adopts a newer version with knowledge_restore_version.

Setup, updates and limits: src/SystemAiCkModel/README.md, section "Blueprint System.Ai.Builder".
